name: LL-37

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: The only human cathelicidin-derived antimicrobial peptide, a 37-residue cationic peptide with both antimicrobial and immunomodulatory activity in vitro. It has no FDA-approved product and no approved human labelling. No FDA label exists.

systems.note: Immunomodulatory and antimicrobial activity is the intended effect.
Cationic peptides carry a general nephrotoxicity concern; uncharacterised for this peptide in humans.
No human safety data and no product-quality control.

monitors.why: Cationic peptide class nephrotoxicity concern with no human data.
